abstract: Generates a symptom-first incident triage and recovery runbook strictly grounded in an existing multi-repo architecture corpus (e.g. one built by architecture-corpus), citing the corpus rather than re-deriving from source, with a monorepo-aware appendix for failures spanning multiple packages inside one workspace repo. Unlike microservice-docs, which documents a single service with no evidence tagging, this skill produces an on-call runbook for a documented multi-repo fleet and never invents tooling or procedures the corpus doesn't support.
